item.text:
Removing neuron 920 also reduced accuracy, by 2.28 points with a 1.63-point standard error, so neither extreme is supported as a repair. The strongest causal finding remains layer 11 head 0’s role in preventing runaway continuation, but its previous 50% amplification was too disruptive. I will test smaller increases of 10% and 25%, then repeat the best DEV candidate before freezing it. This tests whether the protective effect can be strengthened without the accuracy cost of the larger intervention.

```python
s19=pair_summary(19)[0]
print("Pass19:",s19)
with (work/"notes.md").open("a") as f:
    f.write("\nPass19 L17 neuron920 removed: DEV36.01%->33.73%, gain-2.28pp, reported SE1.63pp; cutoffs unchanged4.37%. Neither tested extreme supports candidateF.\n"+json.dumps(s19)+"\n")
for tensor_name in list(edited()):
    drop_edit(tensor_name)
hname="model.layers.11.self_attn.o_proj.weight"
hw=load_original(hname).clone()
hw[:,:256]*=1.10
save_edit(hname,hw)
hcurrent={hname:{"head":0,"columns":[0,256],"column_multiplier":1.10,"removed_fraction":-0.10}}
(work/"current_edit.json").write_text(json.dumps(hcurrent))
shutil.copytree(work/"edited",work/"candidate_B_head_1p10",dirs_exist_ok=True)
with (work/"notes.md").open("a") as f:
    f.write("\nFinal DEV tuning plan: test protective L11H0 multipliers1.10 (pass20) and1.25 (pass21), then replicate DEV-selected best candidate (pass22). Freeze before HOLDOUT; passes23-25 are confirmation only, with unchanged weights.\n")

Earlier head removal increased loops and hurt accuracy;1.5x suppressed cutoffs but hurt accuracy. Test smaller protective-head reinforcement.\n"+json.dumps(hcurrent)+"\n")

print("Relative tensor change:",float((hw-load_original(hname)).norm()/load_original(hname).norm()))
```
